user.title: Petra trip tracker
user.description:
Unofficial integration for school/service transport trips booked through the Petra platform (e.g. Cabonline Serviceresor / Skoltransport).

Paste your login token (JWT). For now you can copy it from the web client: open the browser developer tools, look at a request to the API and copy the value after `Authorization: JWT`. Tokens are valid for about 30 days; you will be asked for a new one when it expires.

reauth_confirm.title: Token expired
reauth_confirm.description: The Petra token was rejected or has expired. Paste a new token for the same account.

error.invalid_token: This does not look like a valid token (JWT).
error.wrong_user: This token belongs to a different account.
error.operator_config: The operator configuration could not be used (API key rejected).
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Petra service.

data.idle_interval_min: Poll interval when no trip is near
data.lead_time_min: Start fast polling this long before a scheduled pickup
data.eta_granularity_min: Fire ETA event when ETA changes by at least
data.heartbeat_min: Heartbeat event interval during a trip (0 = off)
data.late_warning_min: Warn if no car is assigned this long before pickup (0 = at pickup time)
data.failure_alert_min: Fire connection-degraded event after failing for
data.track_onboard: Track the car after pickup (ETA to destination)
data.telemetry: Store redacted API responses locally (for analysis)
